# MPL-2.0 Corresponding Source

These unmodified upstream crate archives provide the corresponding source for the MPL-2.0 packages in the Windows-filtered dependency closure. The source URLs and checksum-verified identities are in `index.json`. Each archive is a gzip-compressed tar file; it can be extracted with `tar -xzf filename.crate`. Preserve the upstream file-level notices and license conditions. They are not relicensed as Apache-2.0. Some packages are only used during compilation; inclusion is conservative and does not imply that each is present in the final executable.
